Represents a resimulated client. If the client gets told the true authoritative state differs from what they, they need to rollback their state and rerun the world with the update. For example, if you have 100 gold coins and the client tells you you actually have 50 gold coins, the client will rerun the logic of the world with 50 gold coins.   

State = state of the game. For example, if you have 100 gold coins, that would be part of the game state.
